meta.title: Noor Club — a monthly Islamic learning pack for your child
meta.description: Printable worksheets, a story, a parent guide and five games. A new theme every month for children aged 4 to 9. First month €1.

hero.title: A monthly Islamic learning pack your child actually wants to open
hero.subtitle: Printable worksheets, a story, a parent guide and five games around one theme. You print, your child plays, and the passport shows what they are learning.
hero.note: No app needed. Works on phone, tablet and laptop.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Every month a new theme is ready for you, from wudu to the 99 names.
how.step2Body: Download the worksheets and let your child play the five games on the phone or tablet.
how.step3Body: XP, streaks and badges let your child grow. You see exactly what they have learned.

inside.title: What is inside a pack
inside.subtitle: Every monthly pack is built around one theme, worked out in four ways.
inside.worksheetsBody: Colouring, writing and cutting. Ready to print on A4.
inside.storyBody: A read-aloud story around the theme, with questions to talk about together.
inside.guideBody: What you tell, what you ask and what to watch for. Two pages, no theory.
inside.gamesBody: Every pack has the same five game types, with new content.
inside.passportBody: Badges per pack, printable. The screen your child shows off with pride.

engines.title: The five games
engines.match: Matching — connect the Arabic word with its meaning.
engines.sequence: Order — put the steps in the right order.
engines.quiz: Quiz — multiple-choice questions about the theme.
engines.listen: Listening — hear the sound, pick the right letter.
engines.wordbuild: Word building — make the word from loose letters.

pricing.title: One price, everything included
pricing.subtitle: All the children in your family, all the packs, all the languages.
pricing.bullet2: Unlimited child profiles in your family
pricing.disclaimer: €1 for your first month. After that €79 per year, unless you cancel within 30 days. You can cancel with one click in your account.
pricing.guarantee: We send you a reminder on day 23, well before the first yearly payment starts.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: For children aged 4 to 9. Every pack has material for ages 4-6 and for 7-9, so brothers and sisters can join in together.
faq.q2: What happens after the first month?
faq.a2: After 30 days your yearly subscription of €79 starts. If you cancel within those 30 days, you only pay the €1.
faq.q3: How many children can I add?
faq.a3: As many as you like. Every child gets their own profile, their own XP and their own passport.
faq.q4: Do I have to print everything?
faq.a4: No. The five games are played on the screen. The worksheets are there for when you want to work offline for a while.
faq.a5: In your account, with one click on ‘Manage subscription’. No email, no phone call.

install.title: Add Noor Club to the home screen
install.body: It then opens like a real app, without an address bar, and your child finds it straight away.
install.guidedTitle: Tip: lock the tablet into Noor Club
install.guidedBody: Go to Settings → Accessibility → Guided Access and turn it on. Then open Noor Club and press the side button three times quickly. Your child can no longer leave the app, and you end it with the same three clicks.
